# SC2012: runtime-injection-disallowed

## Meaning

The compiler emitted this diagnostic for runtime injection disallowed. The declaration or generated contract violates a statically checkable SupaCloud rule.

## Fix

Use typed constructor parameters and compiler-generated scope factories instead of runtime inject() or injection contexts.

## Reproduction

Place the example below in a focused compiler fixture and assert that `SC2012` is reported with a file location. The fixture must fail before the fix and pass after it.

## Failing Example

```ts
// Expected diagnostic: SC2012
import { inject } from "@supacloud/app";
class Service { repository = inject(Repository); }
```
